title: CBDC Ban Has a 2030 Expiration Date
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

**The Senate just handed you a roadmap to the surveillance state — with an expiration date stamped on it.**

They voted 89-10 to ban CBDCs. Buried in the text: a 2030 sunset clause. That's not a victory. That's a schedule. Washington just told you when they're coming back for control.

Meanwhile, Arthur Hayes — a macro operator who doesn't bluff — is holding rocks and Bitcoin. Not equities. Not bonds. That positioning statement matters. The market's now catching up: rate cut prob
